title: African swine fever on pigs confirmed in Agutaya, Palawan
summary: CALAPAN CITY— The Department of Agriculture–Bureau of Animal Industry confirmed a case of African swine fever (ASF) in Barangay Concepcion in Agutaya town, Palawan, the provincial government said…

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The Department of Agriculture–Bureau of Animal Industry confirmed a case of African swine fever (ASF) in Barangay Concepcion in Agutaya town, Palawan, the provincial government said Friday, Sept. 25. In a statement, the provincial government said it was talking with the Provincial ASF Task Force, Agutaya municipal government and other agencies concerned to contain the disease and prevent its spread to other areas. Quarantine measures and checkpoints have been implemented in Agutaya, it said. The provincial government urged residents to remain calm, noting that ASF affects pigs and does not infect humans.
